releaseNotes:
NextGenSoftware.OASIS.API.Providers.SQLLiteDBOASIS v2.0.5

Connects the OASIS to SQLite -- the world's most widely deployed embedded relational database. Stores OASIS holons and avatar data in a local SQLite file with zero configuration and no server required. Ideal for desktop apps, mobile, edge/IoT, or offline-first OASIS deployments. Part of the OASIS HOT-Swappable Provider Architecture. Ecosystem: https://oasisomniverse.one

What's new since v2.0.4
- Add durable SQLite preparation claims with shared ownership contract (481432b)
- Adopt matching SQLite replica lineage atomically with migration receipt (cd712bc)
- Align omitted SQLite comparison masks and verify real V2 reads (ec4d39f)
- Apply exact committed tombstones across Ethereum and SQLite replicas (4fd754d)
- Apply metadata search filters to SQLite avatar results (3859e1e)
- Audit SQLite avatar selector async and error contracts (ea23901)
- Await SQLite avatar deletion graph and transaction operations (ede505f)
- Bind exact SQLite conditional intent and fence historical fingerprints (8399eef)

- Bind SQLite conditional acknowledgements to intact original intent (0b57cfe)
- Bind SQLite indexed queries to shared source evidence contract (230de45)
